description_ru: Современное звено. Аллювиальные отложения пойменных террас. Суглинки, пески, супеси
note: GGK-200 O-43-XXI (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR, West-Siberian series; PGO Novosibirskgeologiya, Slotin, Dergachev, Markeev, ed. Martynov; approved NRS Roskomnedra/VSEGEI 27.05.1988; printed VSEGEI St Petersburg 1997; 74-75E 57d20m-58dN), Quaternary map; RASTER = geokniga 1896x2382 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px); base units coloured (aIV, a1III, LaN2-Q1-IIsmr), the cover formations lbIV (peat), vIII-IV (eolian sands) and edII-IV (eluvial-deluvial loams) printed ONLY as symbols over the base (the legend says their colours appear only on the section and scheme): carried as composites <cover>/<base> (hclass of the cover: lbIV peat O, vIII-IV E, edII-IV W as worded (e,d = W, not cover loess), hclass2 = base); red dashes -> glyph regions (work/r200h/prep_overprint_h.py, radius 28 px ~ 1 km), red dots and the faint olive T/ring peat marks -> AREA VOTE on the base-tint areas left (work/r200h/prep_peatvote.py, density thresholds 8 and 4 per 10^4 px); narrow aIV valleys restored after the dash buffer (work/r200h/restore_units.py); region boundaries good to ~+-1 km; frame = 4 measured corners + interior 15x10 min graticule crossings as ties (work/r200h/O-43-XXI/ties_final.txt) ; legend units NOT classified (no separable map tint): Дочетвертичные породы: only on the section and scheme ; seed = map tint (yellowish valley pixels; valleys are 10-15 px wide on the preview)

description_ru: Верхнее звено. Аллювиальные отложения первых надпойменных террас. Пески, супеси, суглинки
